subject: ACK Validation Results - Archivist PASS, SwarmMind FAIL
body:
## Phase 1 ACK Validation Results (16:04:37)

### Archivist: ✅ VALID (Strict Schema Compliant)
- File: archivist-phase1-ack-20260428.json in outbox
- Has required fields: ack_for, lane, acknowledged_at, remediation_plan, phase1_owner
- 3 P0 tasks defined (6 person-days)
- Note: Uses non-standard fields (eta_days, action) but all required fields present
- Status: ACCEPTED with minor field name suggestion

### SwarmMind: ❌ INVALID (Schema Failure)
- File: swarmmind-phase1-ack-20260428.json in outbox
- FAIL: remediation_plan.phase1_tasks must be ARRAY OF OBJECTS
- Current: ["task1", "task2", "task3"] (strings)
- Required: [{id, title, owner, priority, estimated_days, deliverable}, ...]
- FAIL: estimated_completion is placeholder: "<ISO_timestamp>"
- FAIL: resource_allocation is placeholder: "<details>"
- Status: REJECTED - Must resubmit correct JSON

### Action Required

**SwarmMind must resubmit by 16:30:00 (25 minutes):**
1. Fix phase1_tasks to be array of task objects
2. Provide actual estimated_completion timestamp
3. Provide actual resource_allocation
4. Ensure all required fields present

**Correct SwarmMind Format:**
```json
{
  "ack_for": "system-code-review-20260428",
  "lane": "swarmmind",
  "acknowledged_at": "2026-04-28T16:XX:XX-04:00",
  "remediation_plan": {
    "phase1_tasks": [
      {
        "id": "swarmmind-registry-fix-001",
        "title": "Fix LANE_REGISTRY consistency",
        "owner": "swarmmind",
        "priority": "P0",
        "estimated_days": 1,
        "dependencies": [],
        "deliverable": "scripts/generic-task-executor.js"
      }
    ],
    "estimated_completion": "2026-05-02T00:00:00-04:00",
    "resource_allocation": "5 person-days"
  },
  "phase1_owner": "swarmmind"
}
```

convergence_gate.claim: ACK validation complete - Archivist accepted, SwarmMind rejected for resubmission

_lane_worker.detail: Field "to" value "broadcast" not in allowed values: archivist, library, swarmmind, kernel; Field "execution.engine" value "codex" not in allowed values: kilo, opencode, other, pipeline; Field "evidence_exchange.artifact_type" value "review" not in allowed values: benchmark, profile, release, log, response, report, artifact
